question: 2026年第一季度非取消订单销售额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line.units * line.paid_unit_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue FROM transaction_lines AS line WHERE line.state_code != 'VOID' AND line.occurred_on >= '2026-01-01' AND line.occurred_on < '2026-04-01'

question: 非取消订单按销售渠道统计销售额，结果从高到低是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT CASE line.source_code WHEN 'WEB' THEN 'online' WHEN 'SHOP' THEN 'store' WHEN 'PLATFORM' THEN 'marketplace' END AS sales_channel, ROUND(SUM(line.units * line.paid_unit_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue FROM transaction_lines AS line WHERE line.state_code != 'VOID' GROUP BY line.source_code ORDER BY revenue DESC, sales_channel LIMIT 5

question: 按非取消订单销售额计算，销售额最高的商品是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT item.title AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(line.units * line.paid_unit_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue FROM transaction_lines AS line JOIN merchandise AS item USING (sku) WHERE line.state_code != 'VOID' GROUP BY item.sku, item.title ORDER BY revenue DESC, item.sku LIMIT 1

question: 非取消订单按客户统计销售额，排名是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT buyer.buyer_label AS customer_name, ROUND(SUM(line.units * line.paid_unit_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue FROM transaction_lines AS line JOIN buyer_directory AS buyer USING (buyer_key) WHERE line.state_code != 'VOID' GROUP BY buyer.buyer_key, buyer.buyer_label ORDER BY revenue DESC, buyer.buyer_key LIMIT 5

question: 订单 O1001 包含哪些商品、数量、单价和行金额？
reference_sql: SELECT item.title AS product_name, line.units AS quantity, line.paid_unit_cents / 100.0 AS unit_price, ROUND(line.units * line.paid_unit_cents / 100.0, 2) AS line_amount FROM transaction_lines AS line JOIN merchandise AS item USING (sku) WHERE line.ticket_no = 'O1001' ORDER BY line.sku LIMIT 5

question: 非取消订单中，哪些商品曾低于标价成交？列出商品、标价、最低成交单价和最大单件优惠，按最大单件优惠降序。
reference_sql: SELECT item.title AS product_name, item.catalog_price_cents / 100.0 AS list_price, ROUND(MIN(line.paid_unit_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS min_unit_price, ROUND((item.catalog_price_cents - MIN(line.paid_unit_cents)) / 100.0, 2) AS max_unit_discount FROM merchandise AS item JOIN transaction_lines AS line USING (sku) WHERE line.state_code != 'VOID' GROUP BY item.sku, item.title, item.catalog_price_cents HAVING MIN(line.paid_unit_cents) < item.catalog_price_cents ORDER BY max_unit_discount DESC, item.sku LIMIT 5

question: 非取消订单中，每个销售渠道销售额最高的一笔订单是哪笔？列出渠道、订单号和订单销售额；并列按订单号升序，每个渠道只取一笔，最后按渠道升序。
reference_sql: WITH ticket_revenue AS (SELECT CASE line.source_code WHEN 'WEB' THEN 'online' WHEN 'SHOP' THEN 'store' WHEN 'PLATFORM' THEN 'marketplace' END AS sales_channel, line.ticket_no AS order_id, ROUND(SUM(line.units * line.paid_unit_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue FROM transaction_lines AS line WHERE line.state_code != 'VOID' GROUP BY line.source_code, line.ticket_no), ranked AS (SELECT sales_channel, order_id, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sales_channel ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_id) AS revenue_rank FROM ticket_revenue) SELECT sales_channel, order_id, revenue FROM ranked WHERE revenue_rank = 1 ORDER BY sales_channel LIMIT 5
